title: Urban Oasis
description: Urban Oasis is a concept for a lifestyle brand that merges high tech urban farming with sustainable living products and farming.
direction: Since Urban Oasis merges technology and ecology, the design language focuses on modern minimalism drawn from natural forms. The logo resembles a U shaped pot holding a pixel style palm tree, referencing the oasis itself. The mark is complex in concept yet simple in execution, which mirrors the brand's overall identity: the mix of simplicity, natural greenery, and neon color rendered in precise pixelated geometry is essentially what the brand is about.

Look closer at the silhouette and there's a smile hidden in the U shaped pot, and open arms formed by the leaves. Both were the original spark, the first idea that came to mind when reading the brief. Everything else in the branding stays deliberately simple. Even the billboard is designed on transparent glass so the trees behind it show through, letting the idea show its work rather than explain itself.
